## Analysis overview

Filters to analysis-ready CIBIC-Plus records, produces Week 8 descriptive summaries by treatment, and runs the efficacy comparison model.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSCIBC`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAMCD`: parameter code, restricted to CIBICVAL
- `AVAL`: analysis score
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit number
- `EFFFL/ITTFL/ANL01FL`: analysis selection flags
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
